description: An introduction to selected issues in wireless and mobile networks. Topics include: radio basics, mobility models, location management, handoff, QoS (Quality of Service), MAC (Medium Access Control), routing, and transport protocols over different types of wireless and mobile networks.
preAndCorequisites:
• Complete 1 of:
    • CSC361 - Computer Communications and Networks (1.5)
    • CSC450 - Computer Communications and Networks (1.5)
    • CENG460 - Communication Networks (1.5)
    • ECE363 - Communication Networks (1.5)
    • ECE458 - Communication Networks (1.5)
supplementalNotes:
• Credit will be granted for only one of CSC 463, CSC 569.
  • May be offered as a joint undergraduate and graduate class.
title: Wireless and Mobile Networks
